name: Ezz Steel
source: FY2021 column added from EZZ STEEL REPORTS CONSOLIDATED FY 2021 RESULTS (audited, Egyptian Accounting Standards), published 2 March 2022: key highlights Net sales 67,819 EGP mn, Gross profit 13,770, Net profit before tax 7,172, Net profit 5,398, EPS 6.61 EGP; page 5 cost of goods sold table gives consolidated COGS 54,048 EGP mn. Income Tax is the sum of the deferred tax 844 mn and income tax 930 mn the release states, and profit before tax less that 1,774 mn reproduces the printed 5,398 mn exactly. Amounts stored x1,000,000 in EGP. Sales less COGS is 13,771 against the printed gross profit of 13,770, a one million EGP rounding difference in the release itself, so both printed figures are stored as published. Operating expenses, operating profit and net finance costs are left empty because the release publishes no selling, general and administrative breakdown and no depreciation figure, and the FY2021 audited statements PDF is a scanned image with no text layer. | Ezz Steel Company (SAE) Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, audited, consolidated statement of income, printed in EGP thousands and stored here in absolute EGP | FY2021 operating expenses, operating profit, net finance costs and other operating revenues added from the audited FY2021 consolidated statement of income (page 7), read by OCR: selling and marketing 948,077, administrative and general 1,403,979, other operating expenses 1,177,238, other operating revenues 80,094, operating profit 10,321,103, finance income 136,838, finance cost 3,391,597, FX gain 105,425, net finance cost 3,149,334, all EGP thousands; the sums reproduce the printed operating profit and profit before tax exactly. | H1 2024 column from Ezz Steel Company (SAE) consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2024.
note: Consolidated statement of income, absolute EGP (the audited statement prints EGP thousands). Operating Expenses is selling and marketing plus general and administrative plus other operating expenses. Operating Profit (EBIT) is derived as gross profit plus other operating revenues less operating expenses, which reproduces the printed operating profit of 33640236000 (FY2023) and 15346995000 (FY2022). Income Tax is stored as printed net of deferred tax and is negative in FY2023 because it is a net credit: current tax expense 3745659000 less deferred tax asset 4012487000. The issuer's investor relations page publishes consolidated financial statements up to Q2 2024 only, so FY2024 and FY2025 are not available from the issuer. FY2021 operating expenses, operating profit and net finance costs are now filled from the audited FY2021 consolidated statement of income, which was read by OCR from the scanned PDF. The arithmetic ties to the printed lines to the thousand: gross profit 13,770,303 plus other operating revenues 80,094 less the three expense lines 3,529,294 gives the printed operating profit 10,321,103, and operating profit less the printed net finance cost 3,149,334 gives the printed profit before tax 7,171,769, both in EGP thousands. H1 2024 column added from the consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2024 (limited review, dated 10 September 2024), read by OCR because the PDF carries no text layer: every subtotal ties to the thousand, revenue 100,683,782 less cost of sales 82,637,014 is the printed gross profit 18,046,768, the three expense lines plus other operating revenues reproduce the printed operating profit 10,331,888, operating profit less net finance cost 5,676,643 is the printed profit before tax 4,655,245, and that less total income tax 2,379,319 is the printed net profit 2,275,926. ROE, ROA and debt to equity are left empty for the interim column because they would compare a six month profit with a point in time balance sheet, the same convention the other interim columns in this data set follow.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed sales (net) 100,683,782

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed cost of sales 82,637,014, stored positive like the FY2023 and FY2022 columns

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed gross profit 18,046,768, which equals revenue less cost of sales to the thousand

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: selling and marketing 1,744,371 plus general and administrative 2,339,430 plus other operating expenses 3,804,694 Stored positive like the FY2023 and FY2022 columns of this row.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed operating profit 10,331,888; the printed expense lines plus other operating revenues reproduce it exactly (18,046,768 plus 173,615 less 7,888,495)

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed net finance cost 5,676,643 (finance income 1,447,414 less finance costs 5,794,762 less foreign exchange losses 1,329,295)

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed profit before income tax 4,655,245, which equals operating profit less net finance costs

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed total income tax 2,379,319 (income tax 1,957,149 plus deferred tax 422,170)

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed net profit for the period 2,275,926, equal to profit before tax less total income tax

rows.label: EPS
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed basic and diluted earnings per share for the period 2.93 EGP, which matches the 1H 2024 earnings release

rows.label: Net Margin (%)
rows.source: Net Profit / Revenue for the six months, computed

rows.label: Gross Margin (%)
rows.source: Gross Profit / Revenue for the six months, computed

rows.label: Operating Margin (%)
rows.source: Operating Profit (EBIT) / Revenue for the six months, computed

rows.label: Other operating revenues
rows.source: consolidated interim statement of income for the six months ended 30 June 2024, page 6 of the interim statements, EGP thousands: printed other operating revenues 173,615
